messages.content: Each paragraph of your response must end with the same word it started with, separate paragraphs with a newline. Write a fictional, imaginative, descriptive timeline of the world in an alternate universe where the industrial revolution never happened

message.content:
The world knew a different age, one where no gears turned, no smoke billowed from chimneys, and the rivers ran free. The

In a meadow where no factory wheels turned, the animals roamed free. In

Light spread across the valley, a soft morning glow that had never known the harsh glare of gas lamps. Light

Dream, a world without gears or wheels, where the animals roamed free and the rivers ran clear. Dream
